deployment._comment: A test profile: every session stands alone.

strategy_config._comment: The run entry census (#621): a probe logic that writes one diagnostics row and opens and closes one position, so the session writes every member that hangs on an order or a declared sink. It starts ten minutes before a trading-day boundary (00:00 UTC for crypto) and runs across it, so the session also seals a day and writes its streams' day records (#476).

state_frames._comment: Recorded, so the census sees the state-frame stream.

api_monitor._comment: Switched on, so the census sees the venue API section (#631). The mock adapter calls no endpoint, so the section lists none.
